name: Juurin! Orc Gakuen! ~Tenkousei wa Kasshoku Bitch na Onna Yuusha!?~
original_name: 蹂躙！オーク学園！ ～転校生は褐色ビッチな女勇者！？～
source:
Due to Hero's efforts, the Demon King was defeated.
The long war had ended and peace had returned back to the world.
As expected, did demon troops escape safely... Taking the hand of mankind, they decided to live together.

This is the school, where orcs go.
The orcs full of energy and vigor, became herbivorous and worked hard in pursuit of knowledge.

One day, the female Hero transferred into the class of studious and herbivorous orcs.
That girl was an outrageous slut.
Power, Power, Power. She used it as she pleased.
Indiscriminately, she started devouring the orc students here.

This is the story about the unfortunate orcs who encountered the NEET hero.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=977586]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
在勇者的努力下，魔王被打败了。
漫长的战争结束了，世界恢复了和平。
果然，恶魔大军安全逃脱了吗……拉着人类的手，他们决定共同生活。

这就是学校，兽人去的地方。
兽人充满了活力和活力，变得食草并努力追求知识。

有一天，女英雄转入勤奋好学、食草的兽人阶级。
那个女孩是个令人发指的荡妇。
权力，权力，权力。她随心所欲地使用它。
她不分青红皂白地开始吞噬这里的兽人学生。

这是关于不幸的兽人遇到NEET英雄的故事。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=977586]Getchu[/url]]
